## Review disposition — a14322d

- reviewed head: `a14322d3358b07a7477550b7a7c2bb16caef27d5`
- review source: `fallback:panel`
- lenses: adversarial, correctness

Independent fallback panel for PR #728 at `a14322d3358b07a7477550b7a7c2bb16caef27d5` on 2026-09-10; base `4ee132ae4f4a4a0d0fd600e6da6e5325e5f68b34`.

Disposition: the adversarial and correctness reviews below established no actionable finding in this diff. No fix commit followed the panel. The disclosed #393 source-suite failure remains separate from the approved installed verification; this receipt does not claim a passing local source suite, completed adoption, or expanded fixture authority.

The full CodeRabbit status body was read with `gh api repos/topij/agentic-dev-kit/issues/728/comments --paginate --slurp` and the subsequent `pr_watch.py 728 --json` poll at this head on 2026-09-10. It reports disabled automatic review, with no delivered verdict. The poll reports a trusted current check outage and no pending-bot blocker. This receipt records the independent review actually performed.

Each lens ran as a fresh `codex exec` session in its supplied clone, with the raw pinned diff and no author framing. The launch argv carried `-c model_reasoning_effort="high"`. Runtime `turn_context` readbacks confirmed `gpt-6-astra` and effort `high` for adversarial session `01a08b24-d4b1-7282-b7e7-321b114598f9` and correctness session `01a08b24-d61d-7be1-ac16-97e17534ceca`. Their CLI processes terminated with exit `0`; the reports disclose their verification failures and limits. Verification was serialized by the shared wrapper. The temporary waiting-process inspection did not interrupt another reviewer; queued audits completed and corrected mutation probes reached terminal results.

Panel metadata, launch arguments, events and compute readbacks remain under `/private/tmp/item5-update-panel-a14322d-vlaa2kwp`. Retained fixture/source inventories and Git identities were also independently compared read-only from `/Users/topi/Coding/agentic-dev-kit` at this head on 2026-09-10; `/private/tmp/item5-b-update-author-final-readback-20260910.json` records their equality to the execution evidence and the unchanged predicted baseline hash.

## Adversarial terminal report and full attestation

Reviewed `/private/tmp/item5-update-panel-a14322d-vlaa2kwp/adversarial`. Observed HEAD and reviewed SHA: `a14322d3358b07a7477550b7a7c2bb16caef27d5`.

On 2026-09-10, `git diff --shortstat` against `4ee132ae4f4a4a0d0fd600e6da6e5325e5f68b34` reported `117 files changed, 18180 insertions(+), 39 deletions(-)`. `gh api` and `git ls-remote` independently confirmed the supplied branch/head and current remote base.

**No actionable findings established.** Verification at that revision on 2026-09-10:

- `make test` completed with `1 failed, 2497 passed, 1 skipped`. The failure is the disclosed deep-JSON test; `git diff --exit-code` confirmed its implementation and test are unchanged.
- `audit_evidence.py` and `audit_retained.py` passed through the required wrapper, checking ledger consistency, backup bytes/modes and retained-tree inventories.
- Corrected `mutation_cases.py` detected removed inventory, hardlink and permission guards. Each mutation was verified applied and restored byte-for-byte. Only behavioral probes were selected; no drift-check failure supplied a kill.

Scratch: `/private/tmp/mut-adversarial-a14322d-q8su_4pt`. Private cloning and writes were permitted. Default network/process access encountered sandbox restrictions; elevated verification proceeded. No other reviewer was interrupted.

Final `git --no-optional-locks status --short` was empty; HEAD remained unchanged. I did not author, edit or re-point the supplied tree. All my verification processes finished.

The [full review report](/private/tmp/mut-adversarial-a14322d-q8su_4pt/review-report.md) retains mutation diffs, restoration evidence, commands, sandbox limitations and the initial permission-probe setup failure. No client exercise, installed-suite rerun or rollback execution is claimed.

Reviewed repository: `/private/tmp/item5-update-panel-a14322d-vlaa2kwp/adversarial` (`topij/agentic-dev-kit`). `git rev-parse HEAD` observed `a14322d3358b07a7477550b7a7c2bb16caef27d5` on arrival and at completion. The reviewed revision is that same SHA.

On 2026-09-10, `git diff --shortstat 4ee132ae4f4a4a0d0fd600e6da6e5325e5f68b34...a14322d3358b07a7477550b7a7c2bb16caef27d5` printed `117 files changed, 18180 insertions(+), 39 deletions(-)`. The diff is nonempty. `gh api repos/topij/agentic-dev-kit/pulls/728` returned base `4ee132ae4f4a4a0d0fd600e6da6e5325e5f68b34`, head `a14322d3358b07a7477550b7a7c2bb16caef27d5`, and head ref `chore/item5-b-update-execution-20260910`. Independently, `git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main refs/heads/chore/item5-b-update-execution-20260910` returned those respective hashes. Base currency was established against the remote, not an ancestry test or local tracking ref.

Scratch: `/private/tmp/mut-adversarial-a14322d-q8su_4pt`, freshly created with `tempfile.mkdtemp`; the writable repository is its `repo` child, created using `git clone --no-hardlinks --no-checkout` and detached at the named revision. No existing scratch was removed or reused. Local cloning, private writes and retained-artifact reads were permitted. Default network access failed DNS; elevated remote reads and the network-enabled suite were permitted. Default `ps` and attempts to signal my own waiting wrappers were refused by the sandbox. Elevated process inspection succeeded; the elevated signal attempt found those wrappers already exited. No other reviewer's process was signaled. These were sandbox limitations, not an automatic approval-review rejection.

**Findings:** no actionable regression or imprecision established in this diff by the review and commands recorded here on 2026-09-10 at `a14322d3358b07a7477550b7a7c2bb16caef27d5`. This does not claim a passing source suite.

**Fresh context / No framing / Not the author / Report, don't fix:** I did not write this change, did not observe its implementation, and reviewed the raw diff and retained artifacts. I changed no reviewed repository file and made no repair, tracker write or remote mutation.

**Execute, don't only read / Verified clean:** the observations below are from 2026-09-10 against reviewed revision `a14322d3358b07a7477550b7a7c2bb16caef27d5`, using the private repository above. Every suite, audit-script and mutation invocation was prefixed with `python3 -B /private/tmp/item5-update-panel-a14322d-vlaa2kwp/serial-verify.py`.

- `make test` initially stopped in lint when uv could not resolve the package host; exit `2`, retained in `logs/make-test.log`.
- The network-enabled retry of `make test` completed with exit `2`: `1 failed, 2497 passed, 1 skipped in 505.08s (0:08:25)`. Lint and the Makefile syntax recipe completed before pytest. The failure was `scripts/tests/test_pr_followup_hook.py::test_a_payload_too_deep_for_json_load_still_exits_zero`; see `logs/make-test-network.log`. `git diff --exit-code 4ee132ae4f4a4a0d0fd600e6da6e5325e5f68b34 a14322d3358b07a7477550b7a7c2bb16caef27d5 -- scripts/hooks/pr_followup_hook.py scripts/tests/test_pr_followup_hook.py` returned exit `0` with empty output. The failure matches the disclosed historical result and the implementation/test are unchanged by this PR.
- `python3 -B audit_evidence.py` completed with exit `0`. It checked repository artifact hashes, copied external-ledger hashes, authority packet/ledger hashes against the recorded Git revision, preflight equivalence, approved before/final inventory deltas, baseline serialization, preservation hashes, command/output hashes, terminal summaries and Git checkpoints. Output: `logs/audit.log`.
- `python3 -B audit_retained.py` completed with exit `0`. Read-only inspection verified external backup hashes, tar member bytes/modes, and actual retained source/fixture inventories and HEADs against terminal evidence. Output: `logs/retained.log`. It did not execute any driver against retained paths.
- `git diff --check` reported trailing whitespace in the verbatim retained pytest failure log. The packet explicitly preserves raw terminal logs; this was not treated as an actionable defect or normalized.

The make invocation's environment was `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1`, `DEVKIT_STATE_ROOT=/private/tmp/mut-adversarial-a14322d-q8su_4pt/state`, `UV_CACHE_DIR=/private/tmp/mut-adversarial-a14322d-q8su_4pt/cache/uv`, `UV_TOOL_DIR=/private/tmp/mut-adversarial-a14322d-q8su_4pt/cache/tools`, `RUFF_CACHE_DIR=/private/tmp/mut-adversarial-a14322d-q8su_4pt/cache/ruff`, `TMPDIR=/private/tmp/mut-adversarial-a14322d-q8su_4pt/tmp`, and `PYTEST_ADDOPTS=-o cache_dir=/private/tmp/mut-adversarial-a14322d-q8su_4pt/cache/pytest`.

**Mutation-test new branches:** `python3 -B mutation_cases.py`, with the wrapper prefix above and absolute script path under the scratch root, completed with exit `0` on its corrected run. The first run stopped before applying any mutation: the special-bit chmod setup did not land, as verified with `stat -f '%Lp %N'` showing ordinary permissions. That setup failure is retained in `logs/mutations.log` and `logs/guards-initial-environment.log`; it is not a guard finding or a mutation kill. The corrected probe uses an ordinary mode change and explicitly reads it back before checking rejection.

The probes execute only AST-selected historical helper definitions (`digest`, `inventory`, `safe_regular`, `require_inventory`) with synthetic private paths and stubbed reporting. They do not import or run historical top-level stages. They are reviewer-written behavioral probes, not a claim that the repository suite covers archived drivers. Only these unittest cases were selected; no repository drift/hash test was loaded, so no drift failure supplied a false kill. The unmutated probes and restored probes passed. Mutants failed behavioral assertions as follows:

| Mutation | Behavioral failure |
|---|---|
| Inventory rejection removed | `test_inventory_rejects_byte_tampering`, `test_inventory_rejects_permission_change` |
| Hardlink rejection removed | `test_regular_rejects_hardlink` |
| Permission mode omitted from inventory | `test_inventory_rejects_permission_change` |

The original bytes were saved before edits. Each mutant was re-read, compared with the original, and its intended diff retained before testing. After each case, the original bytes were restored and compared byte-for-byte before continuing. `git show a14322d3358b07a7477550b7a7c2bb16caef27d5:saved_plans/phase5-item5-b-update-evidence_2026-09-10/execute.py.txt | shasum -a 256` and `shasum -a 256 driver.original driver.py.txt` established the original target digest `a2c5d1da08e40d51299d38c247ab01fa5d3cb0ffdefb68844252b15f73c6773d`; final `cmp` returned exit `0`. Per-case restoration readbacks appear below; complete behavioral test failures are retained in `logs/mutations-v2.log`.

**Attestation / No writes in the tree you were given / Right revision:** final `git --no-optional-locks status --short` in the supplied tree returned empty output, and `git rev-parse HEAD` still returned the observed reviewed SHA. I did not detach, switch, re-point or edit that tree. Empty status is evidence against accidental tracked/untracked writes; it does not alone prove absence of ref movement or every ignored/administrative write. My attestation covers the actions; the HEAD readback supplies additional revision evidence. Retained paths and the cockpit were accessed read-only; no original missing path was reconstructed.

Verification limits: no client/trust exercise, fixture PR lifecycle, installed-suite rerun or rollback execution was performed by this lens. The archived installed result was audited rather than re-credited as my own run. Special-bit mutation testing was not established; the corrected behavioral case covers ordinary permissions. The full source suite failed as stated. All my verification processes reached terminal results; none remains queued or running. No other reviewer was interrupted.

On 2026-09-10, `git diff --stat 4ee132ae4f4a4a0d0fd600e6da6e5325e5f68b34...a14322d3358b07a7477550b7a7c2bb16caef27d5` reported `117 files changed, 18180 insertions(+), 39 deletions(-)`. Read-only `gh api` and `git ls-remote` confirmed the supplied base was remote `main` and the branch matched the reviewed head.

Scratch: `/private/tmp/review-correctness-a14322d-oi96126p`. Private cloning and approved network access succeeded; default network access failed, and sandboxed `ps` was denied. I made no edits or checkout/ref changes in the supplied tree. Final `git --no-optional-locks status --short` printed nothing; that status alone does not establish checkout history.

**No new correctness findings.**

Verification at the reviewed SHA on 2026-09-10, using the required serialization wrapper:

- `make test` completed with exit `2`: `1 failed, 2497 passed, 1 skipped in 530.91s`. It reproduced the disclosed, pre-existing `test_a_payload_too_deep_for_json_load_still_exits_zero` failure. [Full log](/private/tmp/review-correctness-a14322d-oi96126p/evidence/make-test-retry.log).
- `python3 -B …/audit.py` exited `0`, checking evidence hashes, command records, summaries, inventory transitions, baseline/configuration preservation, pinned source bytes and replay hashes. [Audit output](/private/tmp/review-correctness-a14322d-oi96126p/evidence/audit.log).
- `python3 -B …/probe.py` exited `0`. Bypassing inventory rejection and removing the hardlink guard each caused its behavioral probe to fail. The [mutation diffs and restoration evidence](/private/tmp/review-correctness-a14322d-oi96126p/evidence/probe.log) show that each mutation landed and was restored byte-for-byte before continuing. These independent probes did not invoke the drift self-check or establish repository-suite coverage.

The historical installed suite was audited through retained evidence, not rerun. No historical stage executed against retained paths. All verification processes terminated; commands and statuses are retained in [review-status.json](/private/tmp/review-correctness-a14322d-oi96126p/evidence/review-status.json).
